content: {"paper_id":"W2626434225","annotations":[{"keyword_id":"subspace-clustering","exact_quote":"Subspace segmentation aims to segment a given data set into clusters with each cluster corresponding to a subspace.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"摘要将子空间分割定义为把数据集聚成与潜在子空间对应的簇，属于按子空间分组的子空间聚类任务。"},{"keyword_id":"sparse-representation","exact_quote":"The proposed model essentially uses l2-norm on the coefficients of highly correlated data points while l1-norm on that of less correlated data points.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"模型对系数施加l1范数使不相关数据的系数趋于零，以少量系数表达样本，体现稀疏表示机制。"},{"keyword_id":"graph-structure-learning","exact_quote":"So, the proposed model can ensure the affinity matrix have two attractive properties: inter-subspace sparsity and intra-cluster uniformity.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"论文以子空间表示构造并确保亲和矩阵具备簇间稀疏与簇内均匀性质，涉及样本间亲和矩阵的学习。"}],"abstentions":[],"input_issues":[]}
